profile_text.body:
IXL Learning operates IXL, which the company's site describes as a subscription-based learning site for K-12 covering math, language arts, science, social studies, and Spanish. The site says IXL is used by over 18 million students and offers personalized learning in more than 20,000 topics, with interactive questions, awards, and certificates. The company describes the product as personalized learning with a comprehensive K-12 curriculum, individualized guidance, and real-time analytics.

Beyond IXL, the company's tracked products include Vocabulary.com, an adaptive vocabulary practice tool for students and teachers. Pricing for IXL has been reported in secondary sources at classroom licenses from $299/year for 25 students and family plans from $9.95/month, though those figures are not independently verified. For Vocabulary.com, district licenses are handled by quote, and one Florida district approved a 3-year contract for grades 7 to 12 not to exceed $226,127.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
